newsitem.title: USA: HealthPlan Services to operate benefits wing.
newsitem.headline: HealthPlan Services to operate benefits wing.

text.p: HealthPlan Services Corp said Friday it has signed a letter of intent to assume operations of Mutual Group Inc's employee benefits business.
The company said the combination is expected to be finalized for an effective date of January 1, 1997. Terms were not disclosed.
HealthPlan Services said it will assume responsibility for operations, marketing and administrative services of Mutual Group's medical, dental and group life benefits business.
The company said the new relationship represents an additional 125,000 members and more than $100 million in premiums, which will generate more than $20 million revenues for its small group division.
